  nFPM is a simple and 0-dependencies apk, arch, deb, ipk, msix, and rpm packager written in Go.                        
         
  USAGE  
         
    nfpm [command] [--flags]  
            
  COMMANDS  
            
    completion [command]  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
    help [command]        Help about any command
    init [--flags]        Creates a sample nfpm.yaml configuration file
    jsonschema [--flags]  Outputs nFPM's JSON schema
    package [--flags]     Creates a package based on the given config file and flags
         
  FLAGS  
         
    -h --help             Help for nfpm
    -v --version          Version for nfpm
